children: News Corp disclosed continued repurchases under its authorized $1 billion 2025 repurchase program, having bought approx. $478,486,339 to date.
Daily ASX filings cover repurchases of Nasdaq-listed Class A and Class B shares under the 2025 Repurchase Program.
To date the company has purchased approximately US$478,486,339 of Class A and Class B shares under the program.
On Sept 15, 2026 the company bought 11,958,019 shares for US$311,496,260.28 (plus 54,641 shares for US$1,659,381.60 in a separate class).
Repurchases are authorized up to an aggregate of US$1 billion; purchases are subject to market conditions and may be in open market or otherwise.
Broker for on-market repurchases: Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC; purpose stated as enhancing shareholder value.
